events.text: 读取会话与用户选中的上下文 / Reading conversation and selected context

content:
The current $ I $ in amperes (A) can be calculated using Ohm's Law:  
$$ I = \frac{V}{R} $$

Substituting the given values:
$$ I = \frac{1\ \text{V}}{1000\ \Omega} = 0.001\ \text{A} = 1\ \text{mA} $$

So, the current is **1 mA**.
